article_title.ru: Память робота может считать время вместо выполненных действий
article_title.en: Robot memory can count time instead of completed actions
article_title.ja: ロボットの記憶、動作回数ではなく時間を数える失敗

caption.ru: Инженеры проверяют виртуальный перенос кубика: женщина работает за клавиатурой, коллега в очках и свитере записывает наблюдения. Редакционная интерпретация статьи об исследовании памяти управляющих моделей Наньянского технологического университета. Робот находится только на экране: описанные опыты проводились в симуляции с заданными паузами. Сцена, люди и геометрия виртуальной руки обобщены и не воспроизводят точную установку или внешность авторов.
caption.en: Engineers examine a virtual cube-transfer task: a woman operates the keyboard while a colleague wearing glasses and a sweater records observations. An editorial interpretation of the Nanyang Technological University study of control-model memory. The robot exists only on screen: the reported experiments used simulation and scripted pauses. The scene, people and virtual-arm geometry are generalised, not an exact reconstruction of the setup or portraits of the authors.
caption.ja: 女性技術者がキーボードを操作し、眼鏡とセーター姿の同僚が観察を記録する。南洋理工大学による制御モデルの記憶の研究を題材にした編集イラスト。ロボットは画面内だけにあり、報告された実験は決められた一時停止を入れる仮想環境で行われた。人物、場面、仮想の腕は一般化した表現で、装置の正確な再現や著者の肖像ではない。

alt.ru: Чёрно-белая гравюра: слева женщина-инженер сидит за клавиатурой и смотрит на большой монитор. Внутри экрана виртуальная шарнирная рука двумя губками удерживает кубик над столом рядом с пустой целевой областью. За пределами экрана робота нет. Справа молодой инженер в очках и свитере пишет карандашом на лежащем на столе листе, придерживая его другой рукой. Монитор стоит на опоре, соединённой с основанием; фон белый, надписей и интерфейсных панелей нет.
alt.en: Black-and-white engraving: at left, a woman engineer sits at a keyboard looking at a large monitor. Inside the screen, a virtual articulated arm holds a cube between two jaws above a table beside an empty target patch. There is no robot outside the screen. At right, a young engineer in glasses and a sweater writes with a pencil on a sheet resting on the desk, steadying it with his other hand. The monitor has a connected stand and base; the background is white, with no lettering or interface panels.
alt.ja: 白黒の版画。左の女性技術者がキーボードを操作して大きなモニターを見る。画面の中では、仮想の関節式アームが二つのつめで立方体を持ち、仮想の台上の空いた目標範囲の隣に浮かせている。画面の外にロボットはない。右では眼鏡とセーター姿の若い男性技術者が、机に置いた用紙を片手で押さえ、鉛筆で記録する。モニターは脚と台座で支えられ、白い背景に文字や操作パネルはない。

visual_thesis: Пауза не добавляет выполненных переносов. Проверка памяти отделяет прошедшее время от истории событий в виртуальном задании с кубиком. Сцена показывает работу с симуляцией: рука и предмет существуют только внутри монитора, а люди управляют проверкой и записывают наблюдения. Она не утверждает, что описанная ошибка уже измерена на физическом оборудовании у заказчиков.
visual_brief:
Use case: illustration-story. Create exactly ONE original landscape 16:9 editorial engraving for a robotics engineering newspaper.

Single story: Nanyang Technological University researchers investigated robot memory in SIMULATION, inserting pauses into repeated cube-transfer tasks. A robot policy can mistake elapsed time for completed work. Do NOT depict an actual physical robot experiment; the robot and cube must exist ONLY inside one physical computer monitor. This is an editorial interpretation of virtual testing, not a reconstruction of the authors' apparatus or portraits of the actual authors.

Style: black ink on pure clean white, mid-twentieth-century Soviet popular-science engraving combined with modern computing and robotics. Confident outlines, expressive large black masses, disciplined moderately spaced hatching and crosshatching, clear silhouettes and generous white areas. Realistic harmonious people with pleasant expressive light faces and hands. Dignified focused technical work. No colour, sepia, toned paper, gouache, neon, ornament, political symbolism, logos, watermarks or readable text. No pseudo-interface, charts, floating graphic overlays, arrows, panels or collage.

One coherent research office scene, three-quarter side view. A plain substantial work desk firmly supported by visible legs. ONE large modern landscape monitor on a connected stable stand, turned sufficiently toward the viewer for its contents to be clear. One keyboard directly in front of it. Monitor, keyboard and people are physically on the same desk plane. Empty restrained background; no posters, wall clocks or extra equipment.

The entire screen contains ONLY a simple monochrome perspective rendering of a virtual tabletop test, no interface chrome, menus, icons, code, numbers, lettering, timeline, graphs or overlays. Inside that screen: ONE simplified articulated robot arm fixed to a virtual tabletop, with a simple opposing two-jaw gripper holding ONE plain cube just above the virtual table. Two jaws contact opposite vertical cube faces; gripper, wrist, links and base are connected. Cube is visibly supported by the jaws, not floating without contact. Show a plain empty target patch beside the cube as part of the virtual tabletop, no labels. Only one arm pose, one cube, no duplicate ghosts, no human in the simulated scene, no numbers pretending to show a result. Keep this virtual image very large and legible at newspaper size. Do not draw an arm or cube outside the monitor. Nothing emerges from the screen. The monitor glass/frame clearly separates the simulated space from the real desk.

People, exactly TWO colleagues with clear professional distance and no touching or romance:
1. A woman engineer about thirty-five, tidy short or tied-back hair, pleasant focused face, practical light technical jacket and trousers. Seated at the left side of the workstation, both hands naturally touching the keyboard, visibly entering the test setup while looking at the simulated arm and cube. Fingers rest on connected keys, wrists and forearms anatomically plausible. She is operating the simulation, not posing or looking at viewer.
2. A young adult male engineer about thirty, short tidy hair, simple eyeglasses, clean-shaven, plain knitted crewneck sweater. Seated at the right end of the same desk well away from her. Concrete action: he records observations on a plain sheet flat on the desk, right hand holding a pencil whose tip visibly touches the page, left hand steadying the paper. His gaze is on the observation record or monitor, never romantic. Keep paper blank without readable marks.

Composition: monitor with its virtual arm-and-cube experiment is the main visual subject, framed by the two active colleagues at a natural working distance. Three-quarter viewpoint must preserve visibility of both the monitor content and the human hand-to-keyboard and pencil-to-paper contacts. Do not hide the screen with a person's head. Human bodies naturally supported by chairs, desk stable, monitor stand fully attached, notebook/sheet flat and supported. Simplify all device geometry to its essential functions; avoid decorative knobs, cables and tools. No mysterious connections, intersecting solids, detached fingers or floating supports. A unified black-and-white print image, no photoreportage claim, no suggestion that the simulation findings have already been reproduced on physical hardware.
